heading.en: Jesus institutes the sacrament among the Nephites—They are commanded to pray always in His name—Those who eat His flesh and drink His blood unworthily are damned—The disciples are given power to confer the Holy Ghost. About A.D. 34.
heading.sm: Ua faatuina e Iesu le faamanatuga i totonu o tagata sa Nifaē—Ua poloaiina i latou ia tatalo e le aunoa i Lona suafa—Ua tausalaina i latou o e e aai i Lona tino ma feinu i Lona toto ma le faaletatau—Ua tuuina mai le mana i soo e faaee atu ai le Agaga Paia. E tusa o le 34 T.A.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Jesus commanded his disciples that they should bring forth some bread and wine unto him.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina poloai atu Iesu i ona soo ia latou aumai ni areto ma se uaina ia te ia.

verses.en: And while they were gone for bread and wine, he commanded the multitude that they should sit themselves down upon the earth.
verses.sm: Ma a o latou o atu mo le areto ma le uaina, sa ia poloai atu i le motu o tagata ia latou nonofo i lalo i luga o le eleele.

verses.en: And when the disciples had come with bread and wine, he took of the bread and brake and blessed it; and he gave unto the disciples and commanded that they should eat.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua o mai ona soo ma areto ma le uaina, sa tago o ia i le areto ma tofitofi ma faamanuia; ma sa ia avatu i le au soo ma poloai atu ia latou aai.

verses.en: And when they had eaten and were filled, he commanded that they should give unto the multitude.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona latou aai ma maoona, sa ia poloai atu ia latou avatu i le motu o tagata.

verses.en: And when the multitude had eaten and were filled, he said unto the disciples: Behold there shall one be ordained among you, and to him will I give power that he shall break bread and bless it and give it unto the people of my church, unto all those who shall believe and be baptized in my name.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona aai ma maoona le motu o tagata, sa ia fetalai atu i le au soo: Faauta, e i ai se tasi o outou o le a faauuina, ma o ia o le a ou tuu atu i ai le mana e tofitofi ai e ia le areto ma faamanuia i ai ma avatu i tagata o la’u ekalesia, ia i latou uma o ē o le a talitonu ma papatisoina i lo’u igoa.

verses.en: And this shall ye always observe to do, even as I have done, even as I have broken bread and blessed it and given it unto you.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou tausisi e faia lenei mea e le aunoa, e pei lava ona ou faia, e pei lava ona ou tofitofi le areto ma faamanuia i ai ma avatu ia te outou.

verses.en: And this shall ye do in remembrance of my body, which I have shown unto you. And it shall be a testimony unto the Father that ye do always remember me. And if ye do always remember me ye shall have my Spirit to be with you.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou faia lenei mea i le faamanatuina o lo’u tino, lea ua ou faaali atu ia te outou. Ma o le a avea lea o se molimau i le Tamā ua outou manatua pea a’u. Ma afai tou te manatua pea a’u o le a outou maua lo’u Agaga e faatasi ma outou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when he said these words, he commanded his disciples that they should take of the wine of the cup and drink of it, and that they should also give unto the multitude that they might drink of it.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona ia fetalai atu o nei upu, sa ia poloai atu i ona soo ia latou ave se uaina mai le ipu ma feinu ai, ma ia latou avatu foi i le motu o tagata ina ia latou feinu ai.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they did so, and did drink of it and were filled; and they gave unto the multitude, and they did drink, and they were filled.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faapea ona latou faia, ma sa latou feinu ma ua malilie ai; ma sa latou avatu i le motu o tagata, ma sa latou feinu, ma sa latou malilie ai.

verses.en: And when the disciples had done this, Jesus said unto them: Blessed are ye for this thing which ye have done, for this is fulfilling my commandments, and this doth witness unto the Father that ye are willing to do that which I have commanded you.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona faia e le au soo lenei mea, sa fetalai atu Iesu ia te i latou: Amuia lava outou ona o lenei mea ua outou faia, aua o lenei mea o le faataunuuina lea o a’u poloaiga, ma o lenei mea ua molimau atu ai i le Tamā ua outou loto e fai le mea ua ou poloaiina ai outou.

verses.en: And this shall ye always do to those who repent and are baptized in my name; and ye shall do it in remembrance of my blood, which I have shed for you, that ye may witness unto the Father that ye do always remember me. And if ye do always remember me ye shall have my Spirit to be with you.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei mea ia outou faia e le aunoa ia te i latou o e e salamo ma papatiso i lo’u igoa; ma ia outou faia e faamanatu ai lo’u toto, lea ua ou faamaligiina mo outou, ina ia outou molimau atu ai i le Tamā ua outou manatua pea a’u. Ma afai tou te manatua pea a’u o le a outou maua lo’u Agaga e faatasi ma outou.

verses.en: And I give unto you a commandment that ye shall do these things. And if ye shall always do these things blessed are ye, for ye are built upon my rock.
verses.sm: Ma ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga ia outou faia nei mea. Ma afai tou te faia pea nei mea, amuia lava outou, ona ua outou atia’e i luga o la’u papa.

verses.en: But whoso among you shall do more or less than these are not built upon my rock, but are built upon a sandy foundation; and when the rain descends, and the floods come, and the winds blow, and beat upon them, they shall fall, and the gates of hell are ready open to receive them.
verses.sm: Ae o soo se tasi e i totonu ia te outou na te faia se mea e sili atu pe itiiti ifo i lo nei mea, ua le atia’e i luga o la’u papa, a ua atia’e i luga o se faavae oneone; ma pe a to mai uaga, ma oo mai lologa, ma agi mai matagi, ma taia ai i latou, o le a pa’u’ū ifo i latou, ma ua uma ona talaia faitotoa o seoli e talia i latou.

verses.en: Therefore blessed are ye if ye shall keep my commandments, which the Father hath commanded me that I should give unto you.
verses.sm: O lea amuia lava outou pe afai tou te tausia a’u poloaiga, ia na poloaiina ai a’u e le Tamā ia ou tuu atu ia te outou.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, ye must watch and pray always, lest ye be tempted by the devil, and ye be led away captive by him.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e ao ina outou mataala ma tatalo e le aunoa, nei faaosoosoina outou e le tiapolo, ma ta’ita’i ese atu ai outou faatagataotaua e ia.

verses.en: And as I have prayed among you even so shall ye pray in my church, among my people who do repent and are baptized in my name. Behold I am the light; I have set an example for you.
verses.sm: Ma e pei ona sa ou tatalo faatasi ma outou ia faapea lava ona outou tatalo i la’u ekalesia, faatasi ma o’u tagata o ē e salamo ma ua papatiso i lo’u igoa. Faauta, o a’u o le malamalama; ua ou faatuina se faataitaiga mo outou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Jesus had spoken these words unto his disciples, he turned again unto the multitude and said unto them:
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona fetalai atu e Iesu o nei upu i ona soo, sa toe liliu atu o ia i le motu o tagata ma fetalai atu ia te i latou:

verses.en: Behold, verily, verily, I say unto you, ye must watch and pray always lest ye enter into temptation; for Satan desireth to have you, that he may sift you as wheat.
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e ao ina outou mataala ma tatalo e le aunoa nei outou ulu atu i faaosoosoga; ona ua manao Satani ia te outou, ina ia lūlū e ia outou e pei o saito.

verses.en: Therefore ye must always pray unto the Father in my name;
verses.sm: O lea e tatau ai ona outou tatalo atu pea i le Tamā i lo’u igoa;

w.en: to the Father in my name;

verses.en: And whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, which is right, believing that ye shall receive, behold it shall be given unto you.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se mea tou te ole atu ai i le Tamā i lo’u igoa, e sa’o, ma talitonu o le a outou maua, faauta, o le a tuuina mai lava ia te outou.

verses.en: Pray in your families unto the Father, always in my name, that your wives and your children may be blessed.
verses.sm: Ia tatalo atu e le aunoa i le Tamā, i o outou aiga, i lo’u igoa, ina ia faamanuiaina a outou ava ma a outou fanau.

verses.en: And behold, ye shall meet together oft; and ye shall not forbid any man from coming unto you when ye shall meet together, but suffer them that they may come unto you and forbid them not;
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ia outou potopoto faatasi e le aunoa; ma ia aua nei o outou faasaina soo se tagata e sau ia te outou pe a outou potopoto faatasi, a ia tuu i latou ia mafai ona latou o mai ia te outou ma aua le faasaina i latou.

verses.en: But ye shall pray for them, and shall not cast them out; and if it so be that they come unto you oft ye shall pray for them unto the Father, in my name.
verses.sm: Ae ia outou tatalo mo i latou, ma ia lē tutulia i latou i fafo; ma afai latou te o mai e le aunoa ia te outou ia outou tatalo i le Tamā mo i latou, i lo’u igoa.

verses.en: Therefore, hold up your light that it may shine unto the world. Behold I am the light which ye shall hold up—that which ye have seen me do. Behold ye see that I have prayed unto the Father, and ye all have witnessed.
verses.sm: O lea, ia tuu i luga lo outou malamalama ina ia susulu atu i le lalolagi. Faauta, o A’u o le malamalama lea e tatau ona outou tuu i luga— mea ia na outou vaai ua ou faia. Faauta sa outou vaai sa ou tatalo atu i le Tamā, ma sa outou molimauina uma.

w.en: which is the of the knowledge

verses.en: And ye see that I have commanded that none of you should go away, but rather have commanded that ye should come unto me, that ye might feel and see; even so shall ye do unto the world; and whosoever breaketh this commandment suffereth himself to be led into temptation.
verses.sm: Ma ua outou vaai sa ou poloaiina ia aua nei i ai se tasi o outou e alu ese atu, ae sa ou poloai atu ia outou o mai ia te a’u, ina ia outou tagotago ma vaai; ia faapea lava ona outou faia i le lalolagi; ma o soo se tasi na te solia lenei poloaiga ua ia tuu o ia lava ia taitaiina atu i faaosoosoga.

w.en: that you might feel and see;

verses.en: And now it came to pass that when Jesus had spoken these words, he turned his eyes again upon the disciples whom he had chosen, and said unto them:
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina ua uma ona fetalai e Iesu o nei upu, sa ia toe liliu atu ona fofoga i luga o soo o e na ia filifilia, ma fetalai atu ia te i latou:

verses.en: Behold verily, verily, I say unto you, I give unto you another commandment, and then I must go unto my Father that I may fulfil other commandments which he hath given me.
verses.sm: Faauta e moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ou te tuu atu ia te outou se tasi poloaiga, ona tatau ai lea ona ou alu atu i lo’u Tamā ina ia mafai ona ou faataunuuina isi poloaiga ia na ia tuuina mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: And now behold, this is the commandment which I give unto you, that ye shall not suffer any one knowingly to partake of my flesh and blood unworthily, when ye shall minister it;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, o le poloaiga lenei ou te tuu atu ia te outou, ia outou le tuuina ma le iloa soo se tasi e taumafa ma le faaletatau i lo’u tino ma lo’u toto, pe a outou tufatufaina atu;

verses.en: For whoso eateth and drinketh my flesh and blood unworthily eateth and drinketh damnation to his soul; therefore if ye know that a man is unworthy to eat and drink of my flesh and blood ye shall forbid him.
verses.sm: Aua o soo se tasi e ’ai i lo’u tino ma inu i lo’u toto ma le faaletatau ua ’ai ma inu e ia le faasalaga i lona agaga; o le mea lea, afai tou te iloa ua le agavaa se tagata e ’ai ma inu i lo’u tino ma lo’u toto ia outou faasa ia te ia.

verses.en: Nevertheless, ye shall not cast him out from among you, but ye shall minister unto him and shall pray for him unto the Father, in my name; and if it so be that he repenteth and is baptized in my name, then shall ye receive him, and shall minister unto him of my flesh and blood.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, aua tou te tuli ese o ia i fafo mai ia te outou, a ia outou auauna ia te ia, ma tatalo mo ia i le Tamā, i lo’u igoa; ma afai e salamo o ia ma papatiso i lo’u igoa, ona outou talia lea o ia, ma tufatufa atu ia te ia lo’u tino ma lo’u toto.

w.en: to the Father in my name;

verses.en: But if he repent not he shall not be numbered among my people, that he may not destroy my people, for behold I know my sheep, and they are numbered.
verses.sm: Ae afai e le salamo o ia, ia le faitauina o ia faatasi ma o’u tagata, ina ia le faaumatia e ia o’u tagata, aua faauta, ua ou iloa a’u mamoe, ma ua faitaulia i latou.

verses.en: Nevertheless, ye shall not cast him out of your synagogues, or your places of worship, for unto such shall ye continue to minister; for ye know not but what they will return and repent, and come unto me with full purpose of heart, and I shall heal them; and ye shall be the means of bringing salvation unto them.
verses.sm: Ae ui lava i lea, aua tou te tulia o ia i fafo mai o outou sunako, po o o outou nofoaga o tapuaiga, aua o tagata faapena ia outou galulue pea i ai; ona tou te le iloa pe o le a latou toe foi mai ma salamo, ma o mai ia te a’u ma le faamoemoe atoa o le loto, ma o le a ou faamaloloina ai i latou; ma o le a avea outou ma ala e aumai ai le faaolataga ia te i latou.

verses.en: Therefore, keep these sayings which I have commanded you that ye come not under condemnation; for wo unto him whom the Father condemneth.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou tausia nei upu ua ou poloaiina ai outou ina ia outou le oo ifo i le faasalaga; ona oi talofa ia te ia o lē e faasalaina e le Tamā.

verses.en: And I give you these commandments because of the disputations which have been among you. And blessed are ye if ye have no disputations among you.
verses.sm: Ma ua ou tuu atu ia te outou nei poloaiga ona o finauga ia sa i ai i totonu ia te outou. Ma amuia lava outou pe afai e leai ni finauga i totonu ia te outou.

verses.en: And now I go unto the Father, because it is expedient that I should go unto the Father for your sakes.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei o le a ou alu atu i le Tamā, aua e tatau ona ou alu atu i le Tamā mo outou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Jesus had made an end of these sayings, he touched with his hand the disciples whom he had chosen, one by one, even until he had touched them all, and spake unto them as he touched them.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona faaiu atu e Iesu o ia fetalaiga, sa ia pa’i atu lona aao i soo, taitoatasi, o e na ia filifilia, seia pa’i atu o ia ia te i latou uma, ma fetalai atu ia te i latou a o pa’i atu o ia ia te i latou.

verses.en: And the multitude heard not the words which he spake, therefore they did not bear record; but the disciples bare record that he gave them power to give the Holy Ghost. And I will show unto you hereafter that this record is true.
verses.sm: Ma sa le lagona e le motu o tagata upu ia na ia fetalai ai, o lea na latou le molimauina ai; ae ua molimau le au soo sa ia tuuina mai ia te i latou le mana e tuu atu ai le Agaga Paia. Ma o le a ou faaali atu ia te outou i se taimi o mulimuli mai ua moni lenei molimau.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Jesus had touched them all, there came a cloud and overshadowed the multitude that they could not see Jesus.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona pa’i atu o Iesu ia i latou uma, sa oo mai se ao ma ua faamalumalu ifo i le motu o tagata sa le mafai ai ona latou vaai atu ia Iesu.

w.en: so that they could not see

verses.en: And while they were overshadowed he departed from them, and ascended into heaven. And the disciples saw and did bear record that he ascended again into heaven.
verses.sm: Ma a o faamalumaluina i latou sa alu ese atu o ia mai ia i latou, ma afio ae i le lagi. Ma sa vaai le au soo ma molimau sa toe afio ae o ia i le lagi.
